messages.author: 760d13932202d6cf
messages.subject: abundance.est in dsm model
parts:
Dear all, 

I am struggling to understand how to access response variable abundance.est in dsm model. At the moment I am fitting  family = quasipoisson(link = "log")
However model diagnostics shows that this distribution family does not fit well.
I tried to fit gamma but I get error: Non-Positive values not allowed for the gamma. 
Where do I get  non positive values from? I am trying to inspect my response variable, but I cannot find the way to access it.

Many thanks for your help,
Olga

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] abundance.est in dsm model
parts:
Olga

The short answer to your question regarding the error arising from trying to fit a gamma is that 0 is a non-positive value.  Therefore segments without detections will have 0 as the abundance; the gamma does not like this.

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] abundance.est in dsm model
parts: Thank you very much Eric for this clarification. This makes sense. What distribution within dsm (or mgcv) can deal with zero-inflation? Segmentation introduces zeros, the number of which which depend on the size of segments. The only option I see is zero-inflated Poisson, however adundance.est is not count. What would be the best way to address this?  Thanks for your help!
